title: Give retirement village inquiry and disclosure documents
what: Give a prospective resident a general inquiry document within 14 days of their request or expression of interest.

sources.title: Retirement Villages Act 2012 (ACT)
sources.quote: The operator of a retirement village must give a general inquiry document to a prospective resident within 14 days after the day the prospective resident— (a) requests a copy of the document; or (b) expresses an interest in the village

sources.title: Retirement Villages Act 2012 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 28, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current republication (Retirement Villages Act 2012 | Acts)
sources.quote: The director-general may approve the form and content of information that the operator of a retirement village must give to a prospective resident of the retirement village.
